subject: Operational runbook + site access & surge coverage for Altura immersion
messages:
From: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.com>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@altura-fin.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-12-01T16:12:00-08:00
Subject: Operational runbook + site access & surge coverage for Altura immersion

Hi Liam —

Thanks again for committing to the onsite immersion the week of Jan 18. To make planning tight and reduce last-minute friction, I put together a short operational runbook and a set of asks so venue access, AV, and travel windows are locked early. Attaching the runbook and a venue access stub.

High-level asks from your side:
- Confirm primary on-site contact for security/badge pick-up (name + mobile).
- Confirm whether external contractors are allowed on-site (we have 2 AV technicians + 1 local liaison).
- If any visitors require escorted access, send full names and approximate arrival times by Dec 10.

Our commitments from Redwood:
- 2x engineers and 1x solutions lead on-site (Ben and Marissa will join).
- Virtual fallback plan if an attendee is remote: rolling session scheduling and persistent Zoom bridge.
- Local liaison will handle badge/parking coordination and quick equipment drop.

I proposed calendar holds for Jan 17–19 (see ICS attachment). Please confirm the contact for badge pickup and whether we need to submit an access form to your facilities team.

Thanks — looking forward to syncing logistics.

— Camila Reyes
Enterprise Solutions, Redwood Inference
camila_reyes@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0123

From: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@altura-fin.com>

Cc: Altura Facilities <facilities@altura-fin.com>, Sofia Mendes <s.mendes@altura-fin.com>
Date: 2026-12-02T09:03:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Operational runbook + site access & surge coverage for Altura immersion

Camila —

Appreciate the detail. Quick answers inline:
- Primary on-site contact: Sofia Mendes (Head of Facilities) — +1 (617) 222-7890. She'll be the badge lead.
- External contractors: allowed but need contractor form submitted by Dec 15 (facilities will send).
- Escorted access: yes for Redwood AV team unless we pre-clear contractor IDs.

I cc'd facilities so they can confirm the contractor intake link and any parking passes. Jan 17–19 works but can we tighten Jan 18 as the day for executive brief + customer Q&A? We'll likely have 10–12 execs on site for half a day.

Also flag: a couple of US-based execs flying in from Europe — visa and arrival windows should be considered.

Liam
Director, Strategic Programs
Altura Financial
liam.oconnor@altura-fin.com

(attachment: venue-access-instructions.pdf)

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@altura-fin.com>
Date: 2026-12-03T11:27:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Operational runbook + site access & surge coverage for Altura immersion

Adding a few operational notes for facilities and travel ops:

1) AV / room setup
- We'll bring a small AV kit (2x wireless mics, 1x laptop with HDMI + Thunderbolt adapters, spare battery banks). If venue cannot guarantee a wired HDMI feed at the front-of-room, we'll need a short rehearsal window (30 min) on Jan 18 at 08:30.

2) Surge coverage & backup routing
- Proposed on-call shift coverage if sessions overrun: 08:00–12:30 and 12:30–18:00 local on Jan 18. Marissa will cover the morning; I'll be on the afternoon shift and available to jump into the Zoom bridge.

3) Access and equipment drop
- Request a small loading bay or secure closet for gear (overnight) — facilities, is there a badge key or temporary locker we can use?

4) Visa arrivals
- If any execs arrive after 06:00 on Jan 18, recommend they join remotely for the morning brief and switch to in-person for afternoon Q&A. We should publish a fallback schedule and send dial-in + local mobile numbers to execs.

I also created a short checklist to be added to the runbook: rehearsal time, equipment list, liaison name, parking passes. Camila — want me to add that and share the updated runbook?

— Ben Carter
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.com | +1 (628) 555-0199

(attachment referenced: AV-kit-inventory.xlsx (stub))

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Altura Facilities <facilities@altura-fin.com>
Date: 2026-12-04T08:52:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Operational runbook + site access & surge coverage for Altura immersion

Hi all —

Thanks Liam & team. Two practical items from scheduling/travel:

A) Local liaison + parking
- Sofia — can you confirm whether visitor parking passes are digital or physical? If physical, please confirm pickup location/time; if digital, please send codes so we can distribute to arriving staff.

B) Tight itinerary for Jan 18 (proposed) — please confirm: 
08:30 — AV rehearsal + tech check (Redwood + venue AV)
09:30 — Exec brief (Redwood + Altura execs)
11:00 — Breakout sessions (3x concurrent rooms)
13:00 — Working lunch + internal alignment
14:00 — Customer Q&A + product deep-dive (main room)
16:30 — Close / transport to executive dinner (off-site)

If breakout rooms are constrained we can run one in-person + two virtual rooms. We'll publish final room assignments by Jan 8.

C) Calendar holds — Camila attached an ICS but I'll post a short yes/no RSVP request (internal) so coverage is explicit. Quick ask: can facilities add a contact card for Sofia to the event invites so badge pickup shows in the event details?

I will merge Ben's checklist into the runbook and push v1.1 by end of day tomorrow.

— Marissa Cole
Customer Success, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com | +1 (650) 555-0246

(Forwarded)

Date: 2026-12-05T16:40:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Operational runbook + site access & surge coverage for Altura immersion

Perfect — thanks for the quick responses, Liam and Sofia. Final checklist items before I close the loop:
- Sofia: confirm contractor pre-clear link or contractor intake form (Dec 10 deadline).
- Facilities: confirm a secure storage location (locker or closet) for equipment overnight.
- Travel ops: we'll publish a fallback remote schedule for any late arrivals by Jan 8.
- AV rehearsal: booked Jan 18, 08:30 — please let us know if that conflicts with building access windows.

I'll upload runbook v1.1 (with Ben's checklist) to the shared drive and re-send calendar invites with Sofia's contact card. Attaching the runbook and the venue access pdf here for your records.

If there are no outstanding asks by Dec 10 I'll treat the plan as confirmed and move logistics to tasking.

Thanks everyone — excited to get this over the line.

— Camila Reyes
